limitations: The pilot has one rater, 25 domes, three fixed-order sessions, and no independent validation panel.
The indices are relative mechanical rankings, not predicted 1-10 ratings or universal perceptual units.
The tactility pilot contains no linear/off observation; a low index does not classify a test as linear.
Part-assembly records are not calibrated and receive no perception index.
Force-wall onset is separate and is never an input to either index.

tactility.label: Pilot-derived tactility-sharpness index
tactility.selection_reason: Force drop had the strongest observed rank association. Combining the correlated family reduced agreement with the pilot.

weight.label: Pilot-derived weight index
weight.selection_reason: Collapse force had the strongest observed rank association. Combining the correlated family reduced agreement with the pilot.
